claims.claim: deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: This is a general business statement and cannot be confirmed by inspecting the specific item.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure or seized pistons.
risks.proof: A video showing the crankshaft being rotated manually or a compression test report.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running core for scrap or parts only

risks.risk: Transmission internal damage or clutch wear.
risks.proof: A video of the donor vehicle driving or a diagnostic scan of the transmission control module.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional unit requiring a rebuild

risks.risk: Catalytic converters may have been gutted or are exhausted.
risks.proof: A clear photo looking into the manifold to see the internal honeycomb structure.
risks.if_unproven: as having no scrap value for precious metals

risks.risk: Incompatibility with the buyer's vehicle due to unknown model/year.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine ID code stamped on the block or the donor vehicle's VIN.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic assembly with high return risk

proof_requests: Photo of the engine model code or serial number stamped on the engine block.
Photo of the manufacturer's logo or branding on the engine or transmission.
Video of the engine being turned over or running.
Close-up photo of the wiring harness connectors to check for cuts or burns.
response.reason: The witness was unable to identify the brand or model of the engine. Without knowing which vehicle this assembly belongs to, it is impossible to determine even a worst-case market price.
